correlation_steps_to_scripts.test_step: Install and Launch the HPX app.
Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Verify shortcuts screen is displayed
Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Verify Add New Shortcut screen is displayed
Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Verify Add New Shortcut title is displayed after clicking create your own
Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Enable the save toggle option in shortcut settings
Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Click continue button to proceed to Add Save screen

automation_scripts_rules.description: For each test step in the correlation, implement the mapped script line and follow all intermediary steps. For steps labeled as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution', always include them even if not in manual steps, as they are required for test case validation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All mapped test steps and implicit/supporting steps for 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on back button in Add print screen.'
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step from the correlation is encountered in automation development, including any labeled as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution'.
THEN: Implement the mapped script line exactly as specified, and follow all intermediary steps (if any).

IMPLEMENTATION: For one-to-one mappings, use the mapped script line directly. For any step that would require multiple script lines, split into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b, etc.), map each to a script line, and enforce sequential execution. For implicit/supporting steps, always include them even if not in the manual test steps, as they are required for test case purpose validation. Do not skip or merge steps. Ensure execution order is maintained.
